## Context checklist

Before requesting review, confirm:

- [ ] `meta.json` is complete and valid
- [ ] `README.md` describes what this iteration shows (audience-facing)
- [ ] `CONTEXT.md` is filled out with all sections:
  - [ ] What I worked on
  - [ ] What was considered
  - [ ] What was deferred and why
  - [ ] What was explicitly not included and why
  - [ ] Parked for later
  - [ ] Open questions for reviewers
  - [ ] Decisions recorded
- [ ] If this iteration supersedes another, `supersedes` field is set in `meta.json`
- [ ] If this is a refinement of another designer's work, original author is tagged as a reviewer
- [ ] Commit messages follow the structured format for substantive commits
